role: microbenchmark_reference_only; excluded from model fitting and independent model tests

divisor_policy: zero-to-one adapter before launch Q; even nonzero divisors retained; raw Div/Mod core contains no safety wrapper
timing: preserve complete Q-D path; reference data is launch Q to last core-owned output point; capture-side wire/hold/reset suffix and clock/setup/skew/uncertainty retained separately
area: disjoint input_service/arithmetic/native_state/external_state/observer/shared_clock_or_physical/root_boundary_repair; unknown functional or sequential ownership rejects
capacity_scope: these17 explicitly enumerated single-atom reference shells only; no stage/state model or wider-domain release
